name: T08 Voter: the receipt finds the ballot exactly as cast
description: After casting, the receipt opens the check page, which lists the ranking in the order it was cast.

planSteps.description: Click the "Rank" button next to Tallinn
Click the "Rank" button next to Valencia
Click the "Rank" button next to Lisbon
Note the receipt code shown under Your receipt
Type the noted receipt code into the "Receipt" field
The ranking is listed in this order: "1. Tallinn", "2. Valencia", "3. Lisbon"
